description: We are Lux Astra, an innovative and imaginative group who are more than willing to undertake the challenge of bringing to life the history of NASA’s space technology through the eyes of its lunar technology, Mars rovers, and deep space probes. We aim to combine entertaining storytelling and real space science to demonstrate that space exploration is available to everyone.
summary:
"The Forgotten Explorers: A Journey Beyond Earth" is a science fiction story for school children. With the help of her own homemade salad-bowl radio telescope, the inquisitive schoolgirl Nova picks up the signal and discovers that NASA’s “lost” spaceships have been communicating with one another for decades. The wise Voyager 1, the cheerful Opportunity, the grumpy Pioneer 10, and the patiently waiting Apollo Moon mirrors are talking about what they have discovered in the real space, ranging from interstellar space to ancient Martian water.
Facing the danger of losing the signal forever due to the approaching solar storm, Nova has to deal with the fading signal, her doubting father, and the disobedient satellite. Saving their stories, she connects all the radio enthusiasts around the world and makes use of the advantages of each device, sacrificing the last device of Voyager.
The short story, with its funny robot characters, humor, science, and "Real Science Check" at the end, helps the children realize that there is no need to be professionals to explore the world.
details:
What it does and how it works:

'The Forgotten Explorers: A Journey Beyond Earth' is a science‑fiction story. It is told as a story and as an animation. I find that the story shows space science in a fun way. Nova, a student with a radio dish finds that old NASA spacecraft have been talking to each other for many years. From their talks viewers and readers learn about Voyager 1s trip into space Opportunitys find of evidence for very old water on Mars, Pioneer 10s strange slowdown and the Apollo laser retroreflectors that measure the distance, to the Moon to a millimeter. The story moves from a mystery to a conflict (a storm, a weak signal, a doubtful parent and a reluctant probe) to a climax where Nova and the machines work together to rescue fifty years of discoveries.

Benefit and Impact on the audience:
Science of space becomes interesting and entertaining due to the storytelling and animation for children. Every scientific fact is told through the mouthpiece of a particular character. Animation makes it possible to visualize the characters of the spaceship, thus helping the younger audience understand it easier. In addition, it is entertaining for the audience who likes to watch more than read. A "Real Science Check" helps to separate facts from fiction. It promotes literacy in science and critical thinking. The main idea of the project is that exploration is not reserved only for scientists.

Tools utilized:
Our story was created with our creative minds based on the concept of curiosity, exploration and collaboration. The scientific facts were checked from real NASA missions’ information, for example, launch date, duration of the missions, and discoveries. Our story came to life. An animation was created based on our story, through the help of Python, Opencode, and Alight Motion.

How it is creative: 

Every spacecraft has a unique personality: the wisdom of Voyager, the joyfulness of Oppy, the grumpiness of Pioneer, and the calmness of Retroreflector. The surprise about all of them is that the machines were not forgotten, only they needed a listener. The solution to the climax depends on the capabilities of each machine, for example, the accurate timing of Retroreflector, Oppy's experience with dust storms, and the famous heat of Pioneer. Therefore, the plot is based on the scientific information.

Factors considered:

  • Audience: The language, sense of humor, pace, and visual images are appropriate for kids.
  • Accuracy: All real facts remain accurate, while the fictional elements are marked as such.
  • Emotion: The moments like sacrifice of Voyager and friendship between Nova and her father are emotional.
